ucs.title: [LLM] Akira ransomware: SSH-tunneled lateral movement + WinRAR-staged exfil to Rclone/Mega
ucs.description: Hunts Akira's characteristic intrusion chain — initial access via SonicWall/Cisco VPN abuse (T1133) followed by Impacket/PsExec lateral movement, WinRAR archiving of staged data, and exfiltration via Rclone/FileZilla/WinSCP to Mega.io or rclone-supported cloud endpoints prior to deployment of the Akira (Megazord/Rust) encryptor. Tied to Howling Scorpius / GOLD SAHARA / PUNK SPIDER as catalogued by CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Unit 42.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("rclone.exe","winscp.exe","filezilla.exe","WinSCP.com") OR (Processes.process_name="rar.exe" OR Processes.process_name="WinRAR.exe") OR (Processes.process_name="powershell.exe" AND Processes.process="*rclone*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval akira_indicator=case(match(cmdline,"(?i)(mega\.nz|mega\.io|mega:|remote:mega)"),"rclone_mega", match(cmdline,"(?i)(-hp[A-Za-z0-9]|-p[A-Za-z0-9]+\s+-(r|m5)|-m5\s+-v\d+m)"),"winrar_password_split", match(cmdline,"(?i)(copy|sync|move)\s+.*\s+\w+:"),"rclone_transfer", true(),"other") | where akira_indicator!="other" | join type=inner dest [| tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("psexec.exe","PsExec64.exe","wmiexec.py","smbexec.py","atexec.py") OR (Processes.process="*\\\\ADMIN$\\*" AND Processes.process="*.exe*") by Processes.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename count as lateral_count] | where lateral_count>0 | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | table firstTime lastTime dest user process_name akira_indicator cmdline lateral_count
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let StagingTools = dynamic(["rclone.exe","winscp.exe","winscp.com","filezilla.exe","rar.exe","winrar.exe"]);
let LateralTools = dynamic(["psexec.exe","psexec64.exe","wmiexec.py","smbexec.py","atexec.py","paexec.exe"]);
let LateralHosts = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ (LateralTools)
       or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("\\ADMIN$\\", "\\IPC$\\", "-accepteula -s -d cmd", "--service-name")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | summarize LateralFirst = min(Timestamp), LateralCount = count() by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where FileName in~ (StagingTools)
   or (FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("rclone","Mega.io","Mega.nz"))
| extend AkiraSignal = case(
    ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(mega\.nz|mega\.io|remote:mega|:mega\s)", "rclone_to_mega",
    ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s(copy|sync|move|lsd|lsf)\s+.+\s+\w+:", "rclone_transfer",
    ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s-hp[A-Za-z0-9!@#\$%]{4,}", "winrar_password_archive",
    ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s-(m5|v\d+[mMgG]|r)\s", "winrar_split_archive",
    ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(sftp|ftps?|scp)://", "winscp_filezilla_transfer",
    "other")
| where AkiraSignal != "other"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| join kind=inner LateralHosts on DeviceId
| where Timestamp between (LateralFirst .. LateralFirst + 24h)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, AkiraSignal, ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName, ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          LateralFirst, LateralCount
| order by Timestamp asc

ucs.title: [LLM] Akira pre-encryption: bring-your-own-vulnerable-driver + shadow copy wipe + LSASS dump preceding T1486
ucs.description: Hunts Akira's pre-encryption sequence: BYOVD-style EDR neutralization (Zemana/rwdrv/gmer/truesight signed drivers), Veeam credential extraction, ntds.dit/LSASS dumping, vssadmin/wmic shadow-copy deletion, and Group Policy push of the Akira binary — the exact 'last 30 minutes' fingerprint reported by CISA AA24-109A, Sophos, and Arctic Wolf for Howling Scorpius / GOLD SAHARA.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.process_name) as procs from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","net.exe","sc.exe","taskkill.exe","rundll32.exe") AND (Processes.process="*shadowcopy delete*" OR Processes.process="*shadows /all /quiet*" OR Processes.process="*Get-VM | Stop-VM*" OR Processes.process="*Veeam.Backup*" OR Processes.process="*credentials*xml*")) OR (Processes.process_name IN ("rundll32.exe","procdump.exe","comsvcs.dll") AND Processes.process="*lsass*") OR (match(Processes.process,"(?i)(zemana|rwdrv|gmer|truesight|aswarpot|kprocesshacker)\.sys")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | stats min(firstTime) as firstActivity max(lastTime) as lastActivity dc(process_name) as distinct_techniques values(process_name) as tools values(cmdlines) as all_cmds by dest user | where distinct_techniques>=3 | eval window_minutes=round((lastActivity-firstActivity)/60,1) | where window_minutes<=60 | convert ctime(firstActivity) ctime(lastActivity) | table firstActivity lastActivity dest user distinct_techniques window_minutes tools all_cmds
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMinutes = 60m;
let AkiraStage = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | extend Stage = case(
        FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"), "shadow_delete",
        FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete", "shadow_delete",
        FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(Get-VM\s*\|\s*Stop-VM|Hyper-V.*Stop|Remove-VMSnapshot|Disable-ComputerRestore)", "vm_or_restore_kill",
        FileName in~ ("net.exe","sc.exe","powershell.exe") and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(stop|delete|disable).*(Veeam|MSSQL|SQLAgent|BackupExec|Acronis|VeeamBackup)", "backup_service_stop",
        FileName =~ "rundll32.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "comsvcs.dll" and ProcessCommandLine has "MiniDump", "lsass_dump_comsvcs",
        FileName in~ ("procdump.exe","procdump64.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has "lsass", "lsass_dump_procdump",
        ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\\(zemana|rwdrv|gmer|truesight|aswarpot|kprocesshacker|partyrocking)\.sys", "byovd_load",
        FileName in~ ("taskkill.exe","net.exe","sc.exe") and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(WinDefend|Sense|MsMpSvc|SentinelAgent|CSFalcon|CylanceSvc|ekrn|McAfee|SophosAgent)", "edr_av_kill",
        FileName =~ "powershell.exe" and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)Veeam.*(Credential|Backup\.Common|xml)", "veeam_cred_dump",
        "other")
    | where Stage != "other"
    | where AccountName !endswith "$" or Stage in ("byovd_load","edr_av_kill");
AkiraStage
| summarize StageFirst = min(Timestamp), StageLast = max(Timestamp),
            DistinctStages = dcount(Stage), Stages = make_set(Stage),
            SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMinutes)
| where DistinctStages >= 3
| extend WindowMin = datetime_diff('minute', StageLast, StageFirst)
| project StageFirst, StageLast, WindowMin, DeviceName, DistinctStages, Stages, SampleCmds
| order by StageFirst desc
